log_level.description: Global logging level. Controls verbosity of messages logged to stderr/syslog.

rsl_ip.description: IP address used for RSL (Radio Signalling Link) connections to the BSC.

bts_type.description: Type of BTS hardware or emulation backend (e.g., sysmobts, sysmoUsim, osmo-bts-trx).

trx_nr.description: Transceiver instance number (0-indexed). Used when multiple TRX units exist.

ts_nr.description: List of timeslot numbers to configure. Each timeslot can be individually tuned.

ts0_arfcn.description: Absolute RF channel number (ARFCN) for timeslot 0.

ts0_bsic.description: Base Station Identity Code (BSIC) for timeslot 0 (6-bit value).

pdch_rate_limit.description: Maximum rate (in kbps) for PDCH (Packet Data Channel) allocations.

pcu_sock_path.description: Unix domain socket path for local management (e.g., by osmo-bsc or CLI tools).

local_ip.description: Local IP address to bind PCU socket (for remote management or proxy).

osmo_bsc_ip.description: IP address of the Osmocom BSC (e.g., osmo-bsc) to connect for RSL and NSVC.

osmo_bsc_port.description: Port number of the BSC to connect (default 4242 for IPA/IP over IP).

max_pdch_alloc.description: Maximum number of PDCHs that may be dynamically allocated per cell.

tbf_ext.description: Enable extended TBF (Temporary Block Flow) support (yes/no).

ta_max.description: Maximum allowed TA value (0–63, per GSM specification).

ta_step.description: Initial TA step size (in bits, ~550 μs each) per update.

ta_tn.description: Initial TA value for new TBFs (timeslot 0 by default).

ta_tn_step.description: Per-timeslot TA update step size (similar to global ta_step but per-TN).

ta_tn_max.description: Maximum TA value per timeslot (same as global ta_max per TN).

ta_tn_min.description: Minimum TA value per timeslot (must be ≥ 0).

ta_tn_initial.description: TA value assigned to new TBFs on a given timeslot.

ta_tn_threshold.description: TA deviation threshold (in bits) to trigger reassignment or rate adjustment.

ta_tn_hysteresis.description: Hysteresis (bits) to prevent jitter in TA updates.

ta_tn_decay.description: TA decay rate (bits/frame) when traffic stops, moving back toward initial.

ta_tn_incr.description: TA increment step for increasing TA (e.g., due to rising delay).

ta_tn_decr.description: TA decrement step for decreasing TA.

ta_tn_step_decay.description: Step decay per frame when adjusting TA downward (e.g., during traffic cessation).

ta_tn_incr_decay.description: TA increment decay factor when rate increases (to avoid overshoot).

ta_tn_decr_decay.description: TA decrement decay factor when rate decreases.

ta_tn_initial_hysteresis.description: Hysteresis applied specifically to initial TA assignment.

ta_tn_threshold_hysteresis.description: Hysteresis applied to threshold-based TA adjustments.

ta_tn_decay_hysteresis.description: Hysteresis applied during TA decay (restoration to initial).

ta_tn_incr_decay_hysteresis.description: Hysteresis during increment decay (rate increase mitigation).
